test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Evident
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hidden**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antonym **means a phrase or word with the opposite meaning as another phrase or word. 
 
• The word **Evident** is an adjective which means seen clearly or in-front of eyes.
 
• The word **Hidden** is an adjective which means not visible.
 
• The meaning of Evident is opposite to the meaning of Hidden,* hence the correct answer is Hidden.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Obvious **is an adjective which is synonym of Evident and it means apparent.

*Example *: Unemployment has been the most **obvious **cost of the recession.

 
• The word **Distinct **is an adjective which means easily distinguishable through the senses.

*Example *: A **distinct **smell of wine.

 
• The word **Apparent **is an adjective which is synonym of Evident and it means clearly seen.

*Example *: She laughed for no **apparent **reason.
